name: acerte-ou-caia
description: ACERTE ou CAIA by BruCe - roda backend e frontend juntos em desenvolvimento

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
